cultural_notes_en: TODO: 3-5 sentences on UK housing rights context. Key concepts: the standard Assured Shorthold Tenancy (AST), the landlord's obligation to make repairs (Landlord and Tenant Act 1985 s.11), how the deposit must be in a government-approved scheme, what Section 21 ('no fault') and Section 8 evictions are, the rule that a landlord must give at least 24 hours' notice to enter, that Shelter (0808 800 4444) and Citizens Advice give free legal advice. Note the difference between social housing (council/housing association) and private rented sector — many learners will be in one or the other but not both.
